acceptance: A PR touching any of the listed paths gets a Trunk-equivalent medium run on its head (same environment, coverage setting and shard scheduling as trunk.yml/trunk-coverage.yml) that must pass before merge; other PRs are unaffected
A workflow test pins the trigger paths and the equivalence with trunk.yml's medium job
The three precedents are shown to fail that pre-merge run when replayed on their heads, or the item records why a precedent cannot be replayed
context: Source: classification of every Trunk push run on develop from 2026-10-10 to 2026-10-24 (recorded on trunk-red-run-triage-20261024; incident ids refer to that table).
description: Three incidents (INC-02, 14, 16; 12 red Trunk runs) came from changes to the Trunk lane itself that no PR run could exercise: #2821 needed a TypeScript package the Trunk medium job did not install; #3200 moved Trunk medium shards under per-test line coverage and pushed datagen tests past their timeouts; #3400 changed shard assignment and exposed a process-global chDB server. A PR that changes .github/workflows/trunk.yml, .github/workflows/trunk-coverage.yml, scripts/release_canary_sharding.py or the medium durations fixture should run a Trunk-equivalent medium job on its own head before merge.
